title: What Makes a Number Prime?
description: A visual sieve that crosses out composite numbers from 2 to 30, leaving only the primes behind.
narration_lines: What actually makes a number prime?
Here are the numbers from 2 to 30.
Cross out every number with more than two factors, one by one.
What's left are the primes, numbers only divisible by 1 and themselves.

params.footnote: a prime has exactly two factors: 1 and itself
